headline: TikTok bans Alex Gibney's Musk documentary social media account
summary: TikTok banned the social media account promoting Alex Gibney's four-hour documentary about Elon Musk just ahead of its wider release. The film's distributor, Bleecker Street, was told the suspension was permanent, according to a report cited in one outlet's coverage. The documentary continues to face resistance from other social media platforms as well.
